newsitem.title: NORWAY: Elkem U.S. unit signs power supply deal.
newsitem.headline: Elkem U.S. unit signs power supply deal.

text.p: Norwegian metals producer Elkem ASA said on Thursday its U.S. subsidiary Elkem Metals Co had entered a seven-year power supply deal with U.S. power producer Allegheny Power.
Elkem said Allegheny would be the sole supplier of electricity to Elkem's plant in Marietta, Ohio. The agreement comes into force on July 1, 1997, pending approval of the Ohio authorities.
Elkem Marietta has an annual power consumption of 800 Gigawatt hours (GWh).
Under the new deal, Elkem will buy 500 GWH in the first two years. At the end of that period Allegheny will be the sole power supplier to Elkem.
